premise: Publicly abandoned at the altar by her fiancé for her cruel sister, a disgraced noblewoman marries a scarred, destitute soldier—unaware that he is secretly a missing Duke seeking justice against the usurpers who stole his birthright.

characters.name: Lady Juliana Ashcroft
characters.role: Disowned noblewoman and skilled herbalist who marries a scarred veteran

characters.name: Alexander (Duke of Ashbourne)
characters.role: Rightful Duke in hiding as a scarred, penniless soldier

characters.name: Lady Catherine
characters.role: Ruthless noblewoman conspiring with Rupert to seize the Ashbourne dukedom

characters.name: Rupert
characters.role: Treasonous usurper claiming Alexander's ducal seat

characters.name: Dowager Duchess of Ashbourne
characters.role: Alexander's captive mother, secretly poisoned by Rupert and Catherine

characters.name: Gerald Harrington
characters.role: Juliana's dishonorable ex-fiancé who abandons her at the altar

characters.name: Lady Clarissa Ashcroft
characters.role: Juliana's spiteful sister who steals Gerald and torments Juliana

characters.name: Prudence
characters.role: Loyal maid who helps Juliana infiltrate Ashbury Manor

characters.name: Father Thomas
characters.role: Corrupt priest carrying on an illicit alliance with Catherine

characters.name: Lord Sterling
characters.role: Corrupt aristocrat aiding Rupert's treasonous takeover

characters.name: High Priest
characters.role: Crown ecclesiastical authority challenging Juliana and Alexander's marriage

selling_reveals: Juliana's scarred, impoverished soldier husband is in truth the rightful Duke of Ashbourne
A scarred war veteran shocks high society by proposing to Juliana moments after she is publicly discarded at the altar

late_payoffs.what: Alexander's mother escapes captivity and reunites with her presumed-dead son, revealing Rupert and Catherine's plot
Alexander breaches the cathedral in full ducal regalia, halts Rupert and Catherine's wedding, and is recognized as the rightful Duke by the royal guards
Crown intelligence exposes the treasonous conspiracy; Rupert and Lord Sterling are arrested
Alexander publicly rejects Catherine and frees Juliana, though the High Priest challenges their union
Catherine is stripped of power and forced to serve as a scullery maid under Juliana
